description: dev_server.stop is not idempotent. Plan AC: 'When called and no child exists, returns { ok: true, stoppedAt: <iso> } (idempotent).' Current implementation returns { ok: false, error: 'dev server is not running' } when no tracked process is found. This violates the documented contract.
suggestedFix: When ProcessManager.stop returns null (no tracked process), return { ok: true, stoppedAt: new Date() } instead of { ok: false, error: 'dev server is not running' }. Update the README accordingly.
